buildSourceNote: Build 137 carries v1.1.0-rc.13. Three more defects were found and fixed on the same live journey after rc.10, each one only reachable once the previous was cleared, and the journey reached the billing stage for the first time in production history. rc.11: the Ready-From-QC queue returned job_card_id, but SAPreInvoicePanel reads j.job_id, so the panel sent the literal string 'undefined', parseInt produced NaN, and the compile call answered 400 'Invalid jobId'. Fixed by aliasing job_card_id AS job_id in getReadyFromQcQueue(). rc.12: billingValidate() raised two blockers that could never be satisfied - BV_LABOUR_PRESENT claimed 'No labour/service items on job' and BV_COMMERCIAL_TAMPERING reported 'Server-recomputed grand_total 0 != stored 2360' - because the validator read job_card_service_item and job_card_parts, which nothing in the codebase writes; both tables hold 0 rows. BV_ validation now passes on itemised rows OR the pre-invoice's own totals OR the captured estimated_amount, using capturedEstimate as the labour fallback so tamper detection is preserved rather than disabled. The sibling checkPhase8Readiness() in the same file had already been retargeted for exactly this reason; this validator had been left behind. rc.13: production has NO security_agent and NO gate_personnel ACCOUNT - zero active users in either role, verified by query - so the gate-out/exit step had no operator at all and no vehicle could be released. On the owner's instruction (2026-09-15) 'reception' was added to GATE_OUT_SECURITY_ROLES, which lets reception (AFROZ, dev-328) call POST /api/gate-out/gate-out, POST /api/gate-out/evidence, the security queue reads, and the SECURITY branch of claim-task. That is a security control handed to a front-desk role and must be reverted by deleting 'reception' from that list the moment a real security_agent account exists. The owner's other instruction, that the GM cover the cashier step, required NO change: GATE_PASS_ISSUE_ROLES already contains gm_service, and gm_service is exempt from full settlement under the 2026-09-14 rule, so the GM (sayeed_dp, user 21) can already record payment and issue the gate pass. The three fixes above shipped as separate builds: 135 = rc.11, 136 = rc.12, 137 = rc.13. See docs/CHANGELOG.md.
